Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 041. 滑动窗口的平均值

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class MovingAverage {
public:
    MovingAverage(int size) {
        arr.resize(size);
    }

    double next(int val) {
        int idx = cnt % arr.size();
        s += val - arr[idx];
        arr[idx] = val;
        ++cnt;
        return (double) s / min(cnt, (int) arr.size());
    }

private:
    vector<int> arr;
    int cnt = 0;
    int s = 0;
};

/**
 * Your MovingAverage object will be instantiated and called as such:
 * MovingAverage* obj = new MovingAverage(size);
 * double param_1 = obj->next(val);
 */
